context: M9 o2. 42nd & Seventh, July 4th night, the street nearly empty. Earl closes up his shine stand.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: Shine's a dollar. Advice is free. The number today is seven-four-one.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: So Carl's got himself a civilian. You know what you are now, Mr. Arce?

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: A tax with legs. Every man on this street plays a number. Cops play the biggest.

lines.speaker: char.earl_poole
lines.text: Here's the envelope. Count it. I already know you won't. You're that kind.

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Used-to-be! You collecting now? That's cold, man. That's cold.
